result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis where it collides with the rating, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off mid-character ('Tokumaru Rame…' with a partial glyph) because it runs into the rating '4.8 (500+)' on the same row, with no ellipsis or spacing.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the title width with flexible layout (e.g., flex: 1, min-width: 0) and apply single-line truncation with an ellipsis, keeping a fixed gap before the rating so the name never clips mid-glyph.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the first 'Popular right now' card has no background container, while the same button on the second card sits on a dark circular backdrop, creating inconsistent affordance and lower contrast over the busy image.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular background to the heart button on all cards for consistent styling and reliable contrast against any image.
